hero.recommended: The driver that fits this card: {name}.
hero.nouveau: This card works best with Nouveau, the open-source driver that comes with the kernel.
hero.packagesReady: The drivers for this card are installed.
hero.packagesMissing: Some of the drivers for this card are missing.
hero.virtual: This is a virtual graphics adapter: there is nothing to install here.

nvidia.title: NVIDIA drivers
nvidia.subtitle: Choose the branch that fits your card. Installing one replaces any other NVIDIA driver. Without an NVIDIA driver the system uses Nouveau.
nvidia.removeAll: Remove NVIDIA and go back to Nouveau
nvidia.confirmInstall: Any NVIDIA driver already installed is removed first, the module is built for your kernels and a restart is needed afterwards.
nvidia.confirmRemove: All NVIDIA and CUDA packages are removed and Nouveau takes over after a restart.
nvidia.needsTuring: Needs a Turing or newer card (GTX 16xx, RTX).

printers.noteDebian: Open source drivers from the maker or the community, from Debian.
printers.noteOfficial: Its drivers are per model: they are downloaded from the official website of the maker.
printers.officialHint: Download the driver of your model from the official page of the maker.
printers.noteCommunity: Unofficial driver, kept by the community.
printers.communityHint: Not from the maker: it is kept by the community. Check the project before installing it.
printers.noteBuilt: Community driver, experimental: it is built on your computer from the project's source, and the camera firmware is downloaded from Apple's servers.

cups.title: Printing system (CUPS)
cups.hint: CUPS, filters, driverless printing over USB and the printer settings tool.

pdf.title: Print to PDF
pdf.hint: A virtual printer that saves any document as a PDF.

gutenprint.title: Gutenprint
gutenprint.hint: Free drivers for many inkjet and laser printers of several makers.

hp.title: HP drivers (HPLIP)
hp.hint: HPLIP with a graphical interface and PostScript. If your model asks for the proprietary plugin, it is added from HP Device Manager.

brother.title: Brother drivers
brother.hint: The free brlaser driver for many Brother laser printers.

epson.title: Epson drivers (ESC/P-R)
epson.hint: Epson's driver for its inkjet printers.

xerox.title: Drivers for Xerox
xerox.hint: The fujixerox and foo2zjs drivers, for Xerox, Fuji Xerox and other compatible models.

ricoh.title: Ricoh drivers
ricoh.hint: Driver for Ricoh Aficio printers of the SP 1000 and 1100 series.

oki.title: OKI drivers
oki.hint: Driver for OKI printers that use the maker's own protocol.

samsung.title: Samsung drivers (SpliX)
samsung.hint: The SpliX driver for Samsung and Xerox lasers based on SPL.

convertibles.note: One package for each Soplos edition: it turns the screen with the accelerometer and sets up the on-screen keyboard that fits your desktop.

nvidia.name: NVIDIA
nvidia.note: Proprietary drivers with CUDA for GeForce and RTX cards.

amd.name: AMD
amd.note: Mesa and Vulkan for Radeon, with video acceleration and OpenCL.

intel.name: Intel
intel.note: Mesa, Vulkan and video acceleration for Intel Graphics and Arc.

vmware.name: VMware
vmware.note: Guest tools: clipboard, shared folders and display.

virtualbox.name: VirtualBox
virtualbox.note: The Guest Additions come from VirtualBox itself, not from Debian.

qemu.name: QEMU / KVM
qemu.note: Agent and SPICE for the clipboard and resolution of the guest.

virtmanager.name: Virt-Manager
virtmanager.note: Graphical manager for virtual machines with KVM and libvirt.

boxes.name: GNOME Boxes
boxes.note: Simple virtual machines, with nothing to set up.

proxmox.name: Proxmox
proxmox.note: The QEMU agent for guests running on Proxmox VE.

amd.title: AMD drivers
amd.hint: Mesa, Vulkan, OpenCL and video acceleration for Radeon.

intel.title: Intel drivers
intel.hint: Mesa, Vulkan and video acceleration for Intel.

virtualbox.title: Guest Additions
virtualbox.blocked: Debian does not ship these tools. With the machine running, use Devices → Insert Guest Additions CD image.

qemu.title: QEMU agent and SPICE
qemu.hint: Shared clipboard and automatic resolution in the guest.

virtmanager.title: Virt-Manager
virtmanager.hint: Includes QEMU and the libvirt service.

boxes.title: GNOME Boxes
boxes.hint: Create and use virtual machines in a few clicks.

pack.vendorConfirm: The official repository of the maker is added, the packages are installed and the repository is removed again. It can download several GB.

amd-rocm.title: ROCm: runtime and OpenCL
amd-rocm.hint: To run compute on the GPU: OpenCL, HIP and rocminfo.

amd-hip.title: ROCm: HIP development
amd-hip.hint: The hipcc compiler and headers to program the AMD GPU.

amd-math.title: ROCm: math libraries
amd-math.hint: rocBLAS, rocFFT, rocSPARSE, rocSOLVER and hipBLAS.

amd-tools.title: AMD tools
amd-tools.hint: radeontop, nvtop, Vulkan and clinfo to see what the card is doing.

intel-compute.title: Intel: OpenCL and Level Zero
intel-compute.hint: Compute on the Intel card with OpenCL and Level Zero.

intel-media.title: Intel: video with oneVPL
intel-media.hint: oneVPL and vainfo to encode and decode video in hardware.

intel-tools.title: Intel tools
intel-tools.hint: intel-gpu-tools, nvtop and Vulkan to see what the card is doing.

oneapi-dpcpp.title: oneAPI: DPC++ compiler
oneapi-dpcpp.hint: Intel compiler for CPU and GPU with SYCL. From the official Intel repository.

oneapi-mkl.title: oneAPI: Math Kernel Library
oneapi-mkl.hint: Intel math libraries, such as BLAS and FFT. From the official Intel repository.

oneapi-vtune.title: oneAPI: VTune Profiler
oneapi-vtune.hint: Intel performance profiler. From the official Intel repository.

oneapi-base.title: oneAPI Base Toolkit
oneapi-base.hint: The complete Intel set: it takes several GB. From the official Intel repository.

cuda-toolkit.title: CUDA Toolkit
cuda-toolkit.hint: nvcc and the CUDA libraries to program the NVIDIA GPU. From the official NVIDIA repository.

proxmox.title: QEMU agent for Proxmox
proxmox.hint: Lets Proxmox shut the guest down and read its network.

nvidia-tesla-470-driver.label: NVIDIA 470 (Legacy)
nvidia-tesla-470-driver.hint: Kepler to Ampere — needs Debian Sid enabled

nvidia-legacy-390xx-driver.label: NVIDIA 390 (Legacy)
nvidia-legacy-390xx-driver.hint: Fermi and Kepler — needs Debian Sid enabled

nvidia-legacy-340xx-driver.label: NVIDIA 340 (Legacy)
nvidia-legacy-340xx-driver.hint: Tesla architecture — needs Debian Sid enabled
